const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboCasa365 ReheatMeal live controller and session notes.
+
+This file is the interaction record/helper for the single eai-standard client.
+The simulator's images and robot proprio are the only feedback used here.
+"""
+import sys, json, time
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+cams = list(spec['cameras'])
+dt = spec['control_dt']
+layout = spec['proprio_layout']
+print('connected', spec['protocol'], 'remaining', spec['budget']['wall_clock_s'], flush=True)
+
+def observe(cameras=cams, depth=True, path='/app/output/obs'):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video='none')
+    if path:
+        o.save(path)
+    print('obs', o.meta.get('control_steps'), o.meta.get('time_left_s'), flush=True)
+    return o
+
+def state():
+    s = r.status()
+    print(json.dumps(s, indent=2), flush=True)
+    return s
+
+def send(q=None, grip=-1., base=(0.,0.,0.), torso=0., mode=-1., n=20,
+         cameras=('robot0_agentview_center','robot0_eye_in_hand'), video='mp4', note=''):
+    """Hold one joint/base/gripper target for n native steps (0.05s each)."""
+    if q is None:
+        p = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none').meta['proprio']['now']
+        q = p[4:11]
+    a = np.zeros(13, dtype=np.float64)
+    a[:7] = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    a[7] = grip
+    a[8:11] = base
+    a[11] = torso
+    a[12] = mode
+    o = r.submit('joint_position', np.repeat(a[None,:], n, axis=0),
+                 cameras=list(cameras), video=video, video_fps=5,
+                 interpolate='hold', note=note)
+    print('submit', o.meta.get('control_steps'), o.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'done=',o.meta.get('done'), flush=True)
+    if o.last:
+        o.save('/app/output/latest')
+    return o
+
+def qnow():
+    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][4:11], dtype=float)
+
+def show_proprio(o=None):
+    if o is None: o=r.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none')
+    now=o.meta['proprio']['now']
+    print({k:round(float(now[i]),4) for i,k in enumerate(layout)}, flush=True)
+
+print('ready; q=', qnow(), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
